note: Premature complete before year-based library cleanup.

strategies.name: BLOCK_RISKY_ACTION
strategies.guidance: Do not call complete_task yet. You still must fetch release_year for library songs and remove those before the required year, then re-list before completing.

strategies.name: VERIFY_TARGET_SET
strategies.guidance: Before complete_task, print every library song with release_year and mark which ones must be removed. Remove only verified matches, re-list library, then complete.

strategies.name: REPLAN
strategies.guidance: Do not complete. Use show_api_doc for Spotify song-detail APIs, fetch release_year for every library song, then remove_song_from_library only for songs before the required year. Re-list the library to verify before complete_task().

strategies.name: LOOKUP_API_SPEC
strategies.guidance: Do not complete. Call show_api_doc for Spotify song-detail and remove-from-library APIs, then finish year-based cleanup before complete_task().
